characters.summary: Erik Killmonger is a highly trained military operative and martial artist who utilizes peak physical conditioning, vibranium weapons, and the synthetic Heart-Shaped Herb to dominate close-quarters combat.

mechanisms: Vibranium Habit suit absorbing kinetic energy
Enhanced durability from the Heart-Shaped Herb

weaknesses: Vulnerability in the suit's sonic stabilizer panel
limitations: Relies on physical proximity or standard weaponry without advanced energy projection

sources.supports: Abilities, equipment, feats, and combat style of Erik Killmonger.

feats.claim: Defeated T'Challa in ceremonial combat at Warrior Falls.

notableResults.note: First duel at Warrior Falls, threw T'Challa over the waterfall.
Rematch in the Vibranium Mines where T'Challa exploited the suit's stabilizer.

conditional.ability: Enhanced physical strength, speed, and reflexes
Kinetic energy discharge and bulletproof protection

campaignTags.claim: Wears a Vibranium Habit suit with energy absorption capabilities.

characters.summary: Kingo is an immortal Eternal who channels cosmic energy through his hands to project powerful energy blasts and projectiles, fighting with the flair of a Bollywood star.

mechanisms: Eternal physiology with enhanced durability and regenerative healing

limitations: Energy projection relies on hand gestures

sources.supports: Eternal powers, cosmic energy manipulation, and history.

feats.claim: Fought Deviants across thousands of years using cosmic energy projections.

characters.summary: Wilson Fisk is a massive, immensely strong crime lord who relies on brutal physical violence, extreme durability, and extensive criminal resources.
weaknesses: vulnerable to psychological triggers regarding his childhood
limitations: Lacks supernatural powers or ranged energy attacks

sources.supports: Physical attributes, criminal empire, and combat encounters.

feats.claim: Overpowered multiple armed security guards and police officers with bare hands.

notableResults.note: Defeated after a brutal street fight.

characters.summary: Korg is a Kronan gladiator made of durable rock-like physiology who possesses immense physical strength and wields heavy weapons in battle.

mechanisms: Sturdy Kronan rock skin providing high physical resistance

weaknesses: vulnerable to losing limbs if detached, though they can reattach
limitations: Slow movement speed due to heavy body mass

feats.claim: Fought in the Grandmaster's Contest of Champions on Sakaar.

campaignTags.claim: Stands significantly taller than average humans as a Kronan.

characters.summary: Loki is the God of Mischief, utilizing illusion casting, duplication, telekinesis, magical dagger projection, and advanced intellect to deceive and defeat opponents.
weaknesses: vulnerable to being outsmarted by powerful cosmic entities

sources.supports: Magical abilities, frost giant heritage, and combat history.

feats.claim: Conquered the mind of Erik Selvig and Clint Barton using the Scepter.

notableResults.note: Subdued by Thor during their encounters.

campaignTags.claim: Casts complex illusions and magical projections.

characters.summary: God of Stories Loki represents an evolved, transcendent form of Loki who wields temporal manipulation and time-weaving powers to hold the multiverse together.
weaknesses: bound to an eternal solitary duty holding the timelines
characters.formDifferences: Transcends standard magic to manipulate time streams directly, acquiring multiversal scale power at the cost of being bound to the End of Time.

sources.supports: God of Stories transformation and temporal powers.

unknowns: Full offensive combat limits in direct physical skirmishes while maintaining the timeline tree

characters.summary: God of Stories Loki operating within or originating from the TVA framework, combining temporal authority with newly awakened god-tier timeline manipulation.
weaknesses: requires temporal mastery to avoid paradoxes
characters.formDifferences: Integrates TVA operational knowledge and temporal technology with his ultimate God of Stories ascent.

sources.supports: TVA association and God of Stories evolution.

unknowns: Exact separation between TVA administrative tech and inherent divine temporal powers

characters.summary: Luke Cage possesses impenetrable skin and superhuman strength granted by cellular regeneration experiments, allowing him to shrug off bullets and throw heavy objects with ease.

mechanisms: Unbreakable skin impervious to standard ballistics and blade attacks

weaknesses: vulnerable to high-grade alien metals or specialized Judas bullets powered by Chitauri tech
limitations: Cannot fly or project ranged energy attacks

sources.supports: Superhuman strength, unbreakable skin, and background.

feats.claim: Stood unfazed while being shot point-blank with multiple handguns.

campaignTags.claim: Advanced cellular regeneration and healing factor.

characters.summary: M'Baku is the leader of the Jabari Tribe, utilizing peak human conditioning, traditional wooden staves, and immense physical stature in combat.
weaknesses: lacks supernatural powers or ranged technology

sources.supports: Jabari tribe combat style and physical feats.

feats.claim: Fought T'Challa evenly for a significant portion of their ritual combat before conceding.

notableResults.note: Defeated in ritual combat at Warrior Falls.

characters.summary: Makkari is an Eternal possessing superhuman speed, allowing her to run across continents in seconds and generate shockwaves through her velocity.
weaknesses: deafness (though compensated by heightened vibration sensitivity)
limitations: Melee range focus relying entirely on speed

sources.supports: Super-speed powers, Eternal physiology, and combat feats.
